rows.note: This is the all-purpose spoken choice for food that gives a hot, burning sensation.

example.english: This dish is so spicy that it makes me sweat.
example.jyutping: ni1 wun2 laat6 dou3 ngo5 ceot1 saai3 hon6

rows.note: Use this mainly for pungent or strongly spicy descriptions, especially in writing.

example.english: This sauce has a pungent, spicy flavor that really stimulates the appetite.
example.traditional: 呢款醬汁味道辛辣，食落好醒胃。
example.jyutping: ni1 fun2 zoeng3 zap1 mei6 dou6 san1 laat6 sik6 lok6 hou2 seng2 wai6
